_comment: Copy to install.config.json (gitignored) and edit. Only includeSkills / includeAgents / excludeSkills / excludeAgents are read — every other key is ignored, so the profiles below are safe reference data.
_rules: EMPTY include list = install everything. That is the default, so an untouched copy of this file changes nothing.
Non-empty include list = allowlist. Only those items install.
Exclude is applied after include, so you can take a profile minus one item.
Anything not selected is PRUNED from ~/.copilot on the next install — switching stacks is: swap the array, re-run.
Unknown names are reported as warnings, so typos will not silently drop a skill.
_locations: <repo>/install.config.json — for local clones of this repo
~/.copilot/install.config.json — required if you install via install.sh (it clones to /tmp and deletes it)

_profiles._usage: Copy one array into 'includeSkills' above. Each profile already contains the _core entries.
